document.title: Kikoto Ferries B2B API — Integration Request/Response Log
document.disclaimer: Bearer tokens redacted. Personal data uses example.com test values. Steps 8–9 are live API captures (2026-07-08). Steps 1–7 from API cache for the same route. Steps 10–12 show the API contract for the booking reference from step 9.

environment.token_note: Token omitted. Use test credentials provided separately.

test_scenario.title: One-way booking with Balearic bonus, bicycle and pet

integration_rules: Filter GET /bonuses by port region in application layer.
POST /prices must succeed before POST /bookings with extras.
Vehicles need passenger_id; pets need operator ticket_type_id.
Confirm uses reference; cancel uses locator.
